reason: $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli and I already have a drawer of half-used bottles. The lab report is nice, but I would wait for a flash sale or coupon instead of paying near full price for a brand I have never tried.
objection: It costs more per day than what I can already get on TikTok Shop, and I have a habit of not finishing supplements, so I would be paying for the box I stop taking halfway.
would_change_my_mind: A flash sale or coupon that brings one box to around $19 to $20, or a small trial pack so I can see if I actually keep taking it.
